title: Quick Jamaican Pasta
description: A winey and crunchy quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring bowtie pasta, made with coconut cream and Whole30-friendly ingredients, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bowtie pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion and red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the dry white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid has almost completely evaporated.
Stir in the coconut cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer while the pasta finishes cooking.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce until it is well coated.
Transfer the pasta to a tagliere vessel and top with chopped fresh cilantro.
